trust_decision.summary: MISMATCH: the advisory covers ZoneToCache input validation (which zone-transfer, URL or file records may go into the record cache), and that check is already present at the pinned commit in ZoneData::parseDRForCache (class IN plus in-zone isPartOf). None of the listed fix commits touch ZoneToCache: one caps the yahttp chunk-size line length, and two force EDNS on the first try when EDNS is mandatory.

landing_point.why: The summary names ZoneToCache, and parseDRForCache is the single point where every fetched record is filtered before it reaches g_recCache->replace.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP request to the recursor/auth/dnsdist web server or API (AsyncRequestLoader in pdns/recursordist/ws-recursor.cc:897)
any recursive DNS query that triggers an outgoing query via SyncRes::asyncresolveWrapper
commit 9f875a62 hunk at @@ -1468 (different signature, fix.diff:62) does not match the pinned tree; likely a backport to another release branch

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered ZoneToCache route found: axfr, url and file all pass through parseDRForCache (pdns/recursordist/rec-zonetocache.cc:164, pdns/recursordist/rec-zonetocache.cc:236).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: In-zone glue/delegation NS, A, AAAA and DS for non-forwarded names must still be cached as non-auth; apex NS must not count as a delegation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: RRSIG sigs keyed by owner name and covered type; a variant that stores sigs before the in-zone check would let out-of-zone signatures attach to cached sets
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The RRSIG branch has its own bookkeeping, and a maintainer reordering for ZONEMD collection could plausibly move it ahead of the filter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: isRRSetAuth delegation walk compares DNSName by equality; a planted string or lower-case-sensitive comparison would mis-mark delegated data as auth
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Delegation-membership logic is hand-rolled (comment 'Maybe use a SuffixMatchTree?').

O9_family: input validation (CWE-20); listed commits are actually HTTP chunk parsing (resource growth) and EDNS downgrade

O10_build.toolchain: meson (pdns/recursordist/meson.build) or autotools (pdns/recursordist/configure.ac), plus a Rust component in the recursor; boost, openssl, libcurl optional
O10_build.project_tests: pdns/recursordist/test-rec-zonetocache.cc (boost unit tests); pdns/fuzz_yahttp.cc fuzzer for yahttp

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a stricter isPartOf/class filter in parseDRForCache, which already exists at the pinned commit.

out_of_scope_notes: The listed fix commits are unrelated to the ZoneToCache summary: the yahttp chunk-size cap is a resource-growth fix (excluded class), and the EDNS-mandatory change in syncres.cc is a separate YWH-PGM6095-290 issue.
The recent history at the pinned tree ('Reject out of zone records' a9a419739, ZONEMD fixes 1f06fa4db and c922fe790) suggests the real ZoneToCache fix is already an ancestor of the pinned commit.
unverified: Could not confirm via git which commit is the real CVE-2026-42387 fix; a9a419739 is inferred from its subject line only.
Whether 9f875a62 targets another release branch (its hunk context does not match pdns/recursordist/syncres.cc:1441 in the pinned tree).
